fixture_updates.observation: South Sydney named Matt Dufty at fullback, Tallis Duncan starting, Adam Elliott on the bench and Euan Aitken absent. Newcastle named Dominic Young and Tyson Frizell after suspension, Phoenix Crossland at hooker and Francis Manuleleua in the second row.
fixture_updates.team_macro_effect: Newcastle continuity counter-case strengthened by multiple verified returns; South Sydney forward continuity improves through Duncan but Aitken remains a verified loss.

fixture_updates.observation: Warriors named Leka Halasima, Wayde Egan, Kurt Capewell and Jackson Ford; Dallin Watene-Zelezniak remains sidelined. Dolphins named Selwyn Cobbo, Kodi Nikorima and Kulikefu Finefeuiaki and are described by NRL.com as full strength.
fixture_updates.team_macro_effect: Both teams gain verified continuity; Dolphins counter-case strengthens materially because the previously provisional Cobbo/Nikorima/Finefeuiaki returns are now official.

fixture_updates.observation: Cronulla named Braydon Trindall at five-eighth and restored Nicho Hynes, Blayke Brailey, KL Iro, Teig Wilton and Thomas Hazelton. North Queensland named Griffin Neame, Jeremiah Nanai and Zac Laybutt. Reuben Cotter is named at lock but remains pending judiciary.
fixture_updates.team_macro_effect: Cronulla spine and senior-unit continuity materially strengthens; Cowboys also regain three starters. Cotter remains a binary unresolved middle-continuity variable until the hearing outcome is verified.

fixture_updates.observation: Penrith named Isaah Yeo to start and Scott Sorensen to return. Sydney restored its rested senior cohort including James Tedesco, Daly Cherry-Evans, Reece Robson, Victor Radley and others; Angus Crichton is named on the bench after 11 games out, while Sam Walker remains out for the season.
fixture_updates.team_macro_effect: Roosters counter-case materially strengthens and the Round 27 50-20 loss remains down-weighted because the Finals side is substantially different. Penrith continuity remains strong with Yeo and Sorensen named.
